info.name: API Reference attributions users > attributions API

items.docs: Call this endpoint to send attribution events made by a single enrolled user for processing. A maximum of 100 events can be included in a single request. Required scopes: `attributions:write`

params.name: offerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the offer being activated

params.name: supportedComponents
params.description: UI component types to include in the offer response (when include=offer).

params.name: include
params.description: Related resources to include in the response. Allowed value is `offer`.

items.docs:
Record when a user activates an offer. Creates an attribution event with eventCode=ACTIVATE and medium=CTA.
Optionally include the offer data by passing `include=offer`.

params.name: placementId
params.description: Unique identifier of the placement (UUID v7)

params.name: slotId
params.description: Stable identifier for the slot within the placement

items.docs: Record when a user activates a batch-activation placement slot. Writes a slot-level `placementSlotAttribution` ACTIVATE event and fans out a per-offer `offerAttribution` ACTIVATE event for every offer resolved by the slot's content strategy. The slot-level event id and the resolved `offerIds` are returned so the partner can render the batch immediately without an extra round-trip to re-fetch the placement content. Required scopes: `attributions:write`
